rapport_notes: Patient, thorough logistics probing, careful with name spelling and address confirmation.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do we have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to address during this call?" - asked right after contact info collection, before any move-logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised a real concern about the movers' experience with a heavy 9-foot couch; rep replied only "Oh, it only to get the big couch. Yeah" and pivoted to the next question with no reassurance about crew experience
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "the last time we take, the less money end up spending by the end of the day" and "if you still have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself"

top_strength: Proactively surfaced the customer's core anxiety (the oversized couch) early in discovery and folded it directly into the item list carried through to pricing.
coaching_note: When the customer voiced concern about the movers' experience with the heavy couch, the rep only acknowledged it factually without reassuring on crew experience/technique - a specific reassurance would have closed the loop.
